dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: ...You're right, dear Luca. I do hope that such a regrettable incident won't happen again.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Why, if it isn't our good friend! What a coincidence, bumping into you! How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: I hope you're right! While there's always something unpleasant to deal with, as we say in Fontaine, "that's life."

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Don't you think so, dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: You see? Luca's wit is as electrifying as ever. I'm overjoyed to hear him answer your question so concisely.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Truly, this was a wonderful encounter for a beautiful day. Goodbye, dear friend.

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Right, are you interested in fishing? In Fontaine, there are all sorts of fish that make fishing truly rewarding. Am I right, my dear Luca?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: #*sigh* Shame, he seems to have his own more...tedious pursuits. Still, I am certain that you understand. Am I right, my dear {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Sonny
dialogues.text: Here's some fresh catch. Please take it. I am sorry to interrupt you, it's just that I really wanted to share this... novel fun of exercising with you.
